license_required.quote: The unlicensed practice of applied behavior analysis is prohibited in this state, except as otherwise provided in Code Section 43-7A-7.

issuing_authority.quote: The Georgia Behavior Analyst Licensing Board is hereby established.

name.quote: The Georgia Behavior Analyst Licensing Board is hereby established.

type.quote: The Georgia Behavior Analyst Licensing Board is hereby established. The board shall be composed of five members appointed by the Governor.

umbrella_agency.value: Professional Licensing Boards Division, Office of the Secretary of State
umbrella_agency.quote: There is created within the office of the Secretary of State the professional licensing boards division

degree_required.value: Master's degree (licensed behavior analyst) or bachelor's degree (licensed assistant behavior analyst)
degree_required.quote: Holds a master's degree based on applied behavior analysis coursework in an approved sequence

degree_level.quote: Holds a bachelor's degree based on applied behavior analysis coursework in an approved sequence

school_approval_basis.quote: Holds a master's degree based on applied behavior analysis coursework in an approved sequence

credential_pegged.quote: Maintains active status as a board certified behavior analyst

Holds a bachelor's degree based on applied behavior analysis coursework in an approved sequence

required.quote: An applicant to be a licensed behavior analyst shall furnish satisfactory evidence demonstrating that the applicant: (1) Has successfully passed a behavior analyst examination conducted by a certifying entity; (2) Holds a master's degree based on applied behavior analysis coursework in an approved sequence; and (3) Maintains active status as a board certified behavior analyst.

experience_source.quote: Maintains active status as a board certified behavior analyst

exams.name: Behavior analyst examination (BCBA)
exams.notes: Conducted by a certifying entity (Behavior Analyst Certification Board, Inc. or successor/accredited entity)
exams.quote: Has successfully passed a behavior analyst examination conducted by a certifying entity

exams.name: Assistant behavior analyst examination (BCaBA)
exams.notes: For licensed assistant behavior analyst applicants; conducted by a certifying entity
exams.quote: Has successfully passed an assistant behavior analyst examination conducted by a certifying entity

interval_years.quote: A license shall be granted for a period of two years.

required.quote: Prior to expiration of a license, the license may be renewed upon submission of an application for renewal, including proof of continued certification by a certifying entity and payment of the renewal fee imposed by the board.

available.quote: The board shall issue a license to a person who is actively licensed as a behavior analyst in good standing in another state if such state imposes comparable licensure requirements as those imposed pursuant to this chapter and such state offers reciprocity to individuals licensed in this state.

requirements.value: Applicants must submit proof of current licensure, current certification by a certifying entity, compliance with ethical standards, and satisfactory results on a criminal background check. The other state must impose comparable licensure requirements and offer reciprocity to Georgia licensees.
requirements.quote: Applicants for reciprocity shall submit proof of current licensure, current certification by a certifying entity, compliance with ethical standards, and satisfactory results on a criminal background check.

exists.quote: The Georgia Behavior Analyst Licensing Board is hereby established. The board shall be composed of five members appointed by the Governor.

national_certification.quote: "Certifying entity" means the Behavior Analyst Certification Board, Inc., or its successor, or another entity that conducts programs to certify professional practitioners of behavior analysis that are accredited by the National Commission on Certifying Agencies or the American National Standards Institute as identified by the board.

regulatory_model.quote: The unlicensed practice of applied behavior analysis is prohibited in this state, except as otherwise provided in Code Section 43-7A-7.

credential_type.quote: The board shall be authorized to: (2) Issue, renew, and reinstate the licenses of duly qualified applicants for licensure

approximate.matched_normalized: issue renew and reinstate the licenses of duly qualified applicants for licensure

is_mandatory.quote: The unlicensed practice of applied behavior analysis is prohibited in this state, except as otherwise provided in Code Section 43-7A-7.

title_protection.quote: No person shall hold himself or herself out to be a licensed behavior analyst or licensed assistant behavior analyst unless he or she is licensed pursuant to this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: The unlicensed practice of applied behavior analysis is prohibited in this state, except as otherwise provided in Code Section 43-7A-7.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license contained in this Code section, or under the laws, rules, or regulations under which licensure is sought or held

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly made misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in practice or on documents
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in the practice of a business or profession licensed under this title or on any document connected therewith

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any felony or crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of any felony or of any crime involving moral turpitude in the courts of this state or any other state, territory, or country or in the courts of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: License revoked, suspended, or annulled by another lawful licensing authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had his or her license to practice a business or profession licensed under this title revoked, suspended, or annulled by any lawful licensing authority other than the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in unprofessional, immoral, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct harmful to the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in any unprofessional, immoral, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct or practice harmful to the public that materially affects the fitness of the licensee or applicant to practice a business or profession licensed under this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aided or assisted an unlicensed person or suspended/revoked licensee to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly performed any act which in any way aids, assists, procures, advises, or encourages any unlicensed person or any licensee whose license has been suspended or revoked by a professional licensing board to practice a business or profession licensed under this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a statute, law, rule, or regulation relating to the licensed profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a statute, law, or any rule or regulation of this state, any other state, the professional licensing board regulating the business or profession licensed under this title, the United States, or any other lawful authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudged mentally incompetent by a court
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction within or outside this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to illness or substance use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Displayed an inability to practice a business or profession licensed under this title with reasonable skill and safety to the public or has become unable to practice the licensed business or profession with reasonable skill and safety to the public by reason of illness or the use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with an order for child support
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to comply with an order for child support as defined by Code Section 19-11-9.3

definition_quote.value: The design, implementation, and evaluation of instructional and environmental modifications to produce socially significant improvements in human behavior, including functional assessment and analysis, interventions based on scientific research, and utilization of contextual factors, motivating operations, antecedent stimuli, positive reinforcement, and other consequences. Expressly excludes psychological testing, diagnosis of a mental or physical disorder, psychotherapy, cognitive therapy, psychoanalysis, and counseling.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of applied behavior analysis" means the design, implementation, and evaluation of instructional and environmental modifications to produce socially significant improvements in human behavior.

value: direct and indirect observation and measurement of behavior and environment
use of contextual factors, motivating operations, antecedent stimuli, positive reinforcement, and other consequences
methods_authorized.quote: includes the empirical identification of functional relations between behavior and environmental factors, known as functional assessment and analysis; interventions based on scientific research and direct and indirect observation and measurement of behavior and the environment; and the utilization of contextual factors, motivating operations, antecedent stimuli, positive reinforcement, and other consequences

tiered_license_levels.quote: "Licensed assistant behavior analyst" means an individual who is licensed pursuant to this chapter to practice as an assistant behavior analyst. "Licensed behavior analyst" means an individual who is licensed pursuant to this chapter to practice as a behavior analyst.

national_certification_body.quote: "Certifying entity" means the Behavior Analyst Certification Board, Inc., or its successor, or another entity that conducts programs to certify professional practitioners of behavior analysis that are accredited by the National Commission on Certifying Agencies or the American National Standards Institute as identified by the board.

national_certification_required_for_lice.quote: Maintains active status as a board certified behavior analyst.

doctoral_tier_recognized.quote: Three members each of whom are either a board certified behavior analyst or a board certified behavior analyst-doctoral and who are eligible for licensure under this chapter.

assistant_analyst_supervision_requiremen.value: A licensed assistant behavior analyst must have ongoing supervision by a licensed behavior analyst in a manner consistent with the certifying entity's requirements for supervision of board certified assistant behavior analysts.
assistant_analyst_supervision_requiremen.quote: Will have ongoing supervision by a licensed behavior analyst in a manner consistent with the certifying entity's requirements for supervision of board certified assistant behavior analysts.

supervisee_technician_exemption.quote: A behavior technician who delivers applied behavior analysis services under the extended authority, close and ongoing supervision, and responsibility of a licensed behavior analyst or a licensed assistant behavior analyst.

family_member_caregiver_exemption.quote: A caregiver of a recipient of applied behavior analysis services who delivers such services to the recipient under the extended authority and direction of a licensed behavior analyst or a licensed assistant behavior analyst.

temporary_license_available.quote: A board certified behavior analyst or a board certified assistant behavior analyst residing and practicing in another state who temporarily provides applied behavior analysis services in this state to a resident of this state may apply for a temporary license to practice behavior analysis in this state.

temporary_license_max_days_per_year.quote: A temporary behavior analysis license may be issued only if the behavior analysis services are to be delivered during a limited and defined period of not more than a total of 30 days within a calendar year

school_setting_exemption.quote: An individual employed by a local board of education performing the duties of their positions; provided, however, that such individuals shall not represent themselves as licensed behavior analysts or licensed assistant behavior analysts or offer or provide applied behavior analysis services to any persons or entities other than their employing local board of education

medicaid_waiver_services_exemption.quote: Individuals providing behavior support services covered under the Medicaid Comprehensive Supports Waiver Program (COMP) or New Options Waiver (NOW) program

organizational_behavior_management_exemp.quote: Professionals who provide general applied behavior analysis services to organizations, so long as those services are for the benefit of the organizations and do not involve direct services to individuals.

nonhuman_animal_behaviorist_exemption.quote: A behavior analyst who practices with nonhuman or nonpatient clients or consumers, including, but not limited to, applied animal behaviorists and practitioners of organizational behavior management.

researcher_educator_exemption.quote: Individuals who teach behavior analysis or conduct behavior analysis research, provided that such teaching or research does not involve the direct delivery of applied behavior analysis services.

value: diagnosis of a mental or physical disorder
scope_exclusions.quote: Such term expressly excludes psychological testing, diagnosis of a mental or physical disorder, psychotherapy, cognitive therapy, psychoanalysis, and counseling.

prescribing_medical_diagnosis_prohibited.quote: Such term expressly excludes psychological testing, diagnosis of a mental or physical disorder, psychotherapy, cognitive therapy, psychoanalysis, and counseling.

criminal_background_check_required.quote: Has received satisfactory results from a fingerprint record check report conducted by the Georgia Crime Information Center and the Federal Bureau of Investigation, as determined by the board.

fingerprint_submission_required.quote: Each applicant who submits an application to the board for licensure agrees to provide the board with any and all information necessary to run a criminal background check, including, but not limited to, classifiable sets of fingerprints.

ethical_code_compliance_required.quote: Conducts his or her professional activities in accordance with accepted professional and ethical standards and guidelines for responsible conduct for behavior analysts established by a certifying entity

advisory_board_composition.value: Five members: three licensed behavior analysts (or initially BCBA/BCBA-D eligible for licensure), one licensed assistant behavior analyst (or initially BCaBA eligible for licensure), and one public member who is not a licensed behavior analyst or assistant behavior analyst and has no material interest in the practice.
advisory_board_composition.quote: The board shall be composed of five members appointed by the Governor.

board_includes_parent_consumer_member.quote: One public member who: (i) Is not a licensed behavior analyst or a licensed assistant behavior analyst or the spouse of such person; (ii) Has never been in the practice of applied behavior analysis or the spouse of such person; and (iii) Does not have and has never had a material interest in the practice of applied behavior analysis.
